CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Tony Chou, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Hunter Chang, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

John Chou, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Calvin Lo, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 26, 2025 AT 8:30 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 26, 2025  PAGE 1 of 6
   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council at
  the meeting.
Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-person comments.
Written Zoom comments will be read or summarized, then printed and made part of the public
record for the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Vice Mayor Chou, and
Mayor Shepherd Romey

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place
limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  CEREMONIAL

 PROCLAMATION OF OCTOBER 10, 2025, AS THE NATIONAL DAY OF THE
 REPUBLIC OF CHINA (TAIWAN)

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  CONSIDERATION OF IMPLEMENTING A NAME FOR THE UNNAMED
  SECTION OF ALLEY NORTH OF HUNTINGTON DRIVE AND EAST OF
  WINSTON AVENUE

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 26, 2025  PAGE 2 of 6
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council provide direction on the requested
  roadway naming request. Should the City Council wish to rename the roadway as
  discussed above, an appropriate motion would be:

  ”I move to approve the naming of the currently unnamed section of alley north of
  Huntington Drive and east of Winston Avenue to the edge of San Marino High School
  as “Lehman Lane” after community member Mitch Lehman.”

2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPEAL FOR VARIANCE NO. VAR 24-01 AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. CUP 24-02 AT 2571 MISSION STREET
  FOR ON-SITE SALE AND CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES
  FOR AN EXISTING DELI/SMALL RESTAURANT (PROVISIONS)
  .…………..
  Recommendation: Pursuant to SMMC Section 23.07.09, upon receiving a notice of
  appeal the Council shall either:

  Affirm the action of the Commission; or

  Require a summary of all evidence upon which the Planning Commission made its
  decision; after receiving such evidence, the Council shall take such action as, in its
  opinion, is indicated by such evidence alone; or

  Refer the matter back to the Planning Commission, with or without instructions, for
  further proceedings; or

  Instruct the City Clerk to set the matter for hearing within seventy-five (75) days
  before itself, unless the applicant and all appellants consent to a later date. At such
  hearing, it shall hear and decide the case de novo. Such hearing shall be conducted in
  the manner and with the notice prescribed by the SMMC for the Planning Commission.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

3.  PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-25-
  1421 (SECOND READING) AND URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. O-25-1423-
  U, ADOPTING THE 2025 EDITIONS OF THE CALIFORNIA BUILDING
  STANDARDS CODES AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-25-23

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council conduct the public hearing, adopt
  Ordinance No. O-25-1421, Urgency Ordinance No. O-25-1423-U and adopt Resolution
  No. R-25-23. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, the appropriate
  motion would be: …………………………………………………………………………………………

  “I move to waive full reading and adopt Ordinance No. O-25-1421, an Ordinance of
  the City of San Marino Adopting by Reference the 2025 Editions of the California
  Administrative, Building, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electrical, Residential, Fire, Energy,
  Green Building Standards, Historical Building, Existing Building, Appendix J Los Angeles
  County Grading Standards and Referenced Standards Codes, with Certain
  Amendments, Deletions and Additions, and Amending Chapter 25 of the San Marino

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 26, 2025  PAGE 3 of 6
   Municipal Code, and Urgency Ordinance No. O-25-1423-U, an urgency version of
  Ordinance No. O-25-1421, and to adopt Resolution No. R-25-23.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

4.  AWARD OF A CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT TO G2 CONSTRUCTION,
  INC. FOR THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF CATCH BASIN TRASH
  AND DEBRIS CAPTURE DEVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $150,000

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the procurement and
  installation of trash and debris capture devices from G2 Construction, Inc. in the
  amount of $150,000. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:  .….

  “I move to approve the Construction Agreement for the procurement and installation
  of trash and debris capture devices from G2 Construction, Inc. in the amount of
  $150,000.”

5.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-25-1422 (SECOND READING) AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL AMENDING SECTION
  2.05.01 OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE TO RESTATE INDIVIDUALS EXEMPT
  FROM THE CITY’S CLASSIFIED SERVICE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Ordinance No. O-25-1422, an
  Ordinance of the San Marino City Council amending Section 2.05.01 of the Municipal
  Code to clarify which offices, positions, and employments are exempt from the City’s
  Classified Service. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation an
  appropriate motion would be:  .

  “I move to approve Ordinance No. O-25-1422, an Ordinance of the San Marino City
  Council amending Section 2.05.01 of the Municipal Code to restate individuals exempt
  from the City’s Classified Service.”

6.  APPROVE RESOLUTION R-25-30 ADOPTING THE UPDATED SEWER
  SYSTEM MANAGEMENT PLAN (SSMP) IN COMPLIANCE WITH STATE
  WATER RESOURCES CONTROL BOARD ORDER NO. 2022-0103-DWQ
  AND AUTHORIZING THE LEGALLY RESPONSIBLE OFFICIAL TO CERTIFY
  AND SUBMIT THE SSMP TO THE CALIFORNIA STATE WATER
  RESOURCES CONTROL BOARD

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve Resolution R-25-30
  adopting the 2025 Sewer System Management Plan (SSMP) Update and authorizing
  the Legally Responsible Official to certify and submit the SSMP to the State Water
  Resources Control Board. If Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:  .

  “I move to approve Resolution R-25-30 adopting the updated Sewer System

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 26, 2025  PAGE 4 of 6
   Management Plan (SSMP) in compliance with State Water Resources Control Board
  Order No. 2022-0103-DWQ and authorizing the Legally Responsible Official to certify
  and submit the SSMP to the California State Water Resources Control Board.”

 7.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION R-25-28 ESTABLISHING AN ELECTRONIC
  SIGNATURE POLICY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt a Resolution establishing an
  Electronic Signature Policy for select City documents to provide City Staff and external
  partners with an alternative method to secure legally binding signatures and
  authorizations. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  ”I move to adopt Resolution No. R-25-28 establishing an Electronic Signature Policy.”

 8.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF AUGUST 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of August
  2025.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
